disorder-name.detail: Persistent ADHD in adults, diagnosed by DSM-IV criteria confirmed via DIVA (Diagnostic Interview for ADHD in Adults). All participants had established childhood history and persistent ADHD diagnosis.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We selected adult participants with persistent ADHD and healthy individuals from the Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We selected adult participants with persistent ADHD and healthy individuals from the Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT; Hoogman et al., 2011; Mostert et al., 2015), based on data availability for structural MRI images."
